# Dr. Amanda Foo-Ryland

> Dr. Amanda Foo-Ryland is an international keynote speaker and #1 best selling author with over 30 years of experience in human development and coaching. She helps people build mental resilience and live passionately.

Website: https://dramandafoo-ryland.com/
Contact: amanda@yourlifeliveit.com (enquiries form at https://dramandafoo-ryland.com/#getintouch)

## About
- From the UK, lives in Portugal and travels the world running courses in New Zealand, Australia and the UK.
- Worked in the corporate world for 16 years with the Estée Lauder group, finishing as Clinique Director of Education for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, based in London.
- Her keynotes focus on mental resilience and mental wellbeing in the face of adversity.
- Her TEDx talk has over a million views and runs 9 minutes.
